records.title: HetHub: A Heterogeneous distributed hybrid training system for large-scale models

records.title: Compass: A Decentralized Scheduler for Latency-Sensitive ML Workflows

records.title: RynnBrain: Open Embodied Foundation Models

records.reason: VisuLogicはマルチモーダルLLMの視覚推論能力を測るベンチマークの提案と評価分析であり、能力評価のみで推論・サービング・デコード等の推論システムへの直接の技術的貢献はない。

records.title: Knowledge Integrity in Large Language Models: A State-of-The-Art Review

records.title: Nautilus Compass: Black-box Persona Drift Detection for Production LLM Agents

records.title: Quantifying the Generation Modality Gap in Speech-Text Language Models

records.title: Anchored Diffusion Language Model

records.title: Backdooring Masked Diffusion Language Models

records.title: Sparse Token Routing in Efficient Transformers

records.title: ELF-REG: Scaling Continuous Diffusion Language Models to Reasoning Tasks

records.title: LED: Improving Masked Diffusion Language Models by Lookahead Editing

records.title: Failures to Surface Harmful Contents in Video Large Language Models
records.reason: 本論文は動画LLMが有害コンテンツを表出できない失敗モードの安全性分析であり、フレームサンプリング等の要因分析はあるものの、推論システムの効率化を目的とした技術的貢献ではない。

records.title: Transfer Learning for Text Diffusion Models

records.title: When AllClose Fails: Round-Off Error Estimation for Deep Learning Programs

records.title: A Practical and Privacy-Preserving Framework for Real-World Large Language Model Services

records.title: MemTX: Transactional Belief Commit for Stateful Agent Memory
